questions.question: What does Isaiah 26 say God keeps in perfect peace?
options: The one who is exceedingly wealthy and gives freely to the poor
The one who is very strong and mighty and skilled in battle
The one whose mind is stayed on him, because he trusts in him
The one who offers up very many sacrifices upon the altar
questions.answer: The one whose mind is stayed on him, because he trusts in him

questions.question: In whom does Isaiah 26 urge trust forever?
options: The army, for it guards the city walls
The king, for he leads all of the people to victory
The LORD, for the LORD GOD is an everlasting rock
The wise, for their counsel will not fail
questions.answer: The LORD, for the LORD GOD is an everlasting rock
